name: CDATASection
title: CDATASection — nodeType 4
description: XML-only CDATA node, a subtype of Text. In text/html, CDATA syntax is permitted inside foreign content but parses into Text nodes, not CDATASection nodes.

serialization.text_html: Not producible by the HTML parser. In text/html, <![CDATA[...]]> is only recognised inside foreign (SVG/MathML) content and parses to a Text node; elsewhere it is a bogus Comment.

creation: document.createCDATASection(data) on an XML document only; it throws NotSupportedError on an HTML document

notes.note: createCDATASection() throws in HTML documents; in HTML syntax, CDATA sections exist only inside foreign (SVG/MathML) content and become Text.

example:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <desc><![CDATA[literal <text> here]]></desc>
</svg>
<!-- In an XML document this is a CDATASection; the text/html parser yields a Text node -->
